title: Misty Step accepts target far beyond its range (12 cells)
steps: cast misty-step x=500 y=500 from 198,287 (rules say range 12)
happened: "Cast. 500,500 grass ... You cast Misty Step", no refusal, no out-of-range message; position readout still 198,287
expected: Refusal as out of range, or clamp to range
evidence: tool output #36; rules misty-step range 12. Fire-bolt/fireball also cast at 100-300 cells away with no range limit.

title: Molten Boulder lava never cools, even with water on it
steps: fresh; cast molten-boulder x=205 y=290 (charge 1); wait 600 ticks; cell 205,290; cast create-water charge 3 there; wait 500 ticks; cell again
happened: Cell stays 'lava, height -1' after 1100 ticks, still 'lava' with liquid water 6 and steam sitting on it. Lava-pool spell lava set into rock after water (lava hisses and sets into rock).
expected: Lava from crater should crust/cool (terrain lava crustsTo lava-crust, waterTo steam) or at least be cooled by water, like lava-pool is.
evidence: cell 205,290 at tick 1100: 'lava, height -1, liquid water 6, gas steam 1'. Also stayed lava through a 5-minute storm in a previous run.

title: Rolling Boulder starts at the clicked cell, not from the caster; creatures in between untouched
steps: fresh; spawn goblin 198,283 (caster at 198,287); cast rolling-boulder x=198 y=277 charge 3; wait 80; creatures; map around 198,277
happened: Goblin 4 cells in front of caster, on the line, stays 10/10 hp, no knock-down. Dust appears only around the target cell (198,275-277); log says 'comes to rest | A pillar of earth rises' but no pillar/boulder terrain found anywhere (census r=14 shows only grass/dirt). Earlier, standing at 332,238 and aiming at 332,250 (12 cells, rule length 10) also produced 'pillar' at the target cell.
expected: Per rules (shape line, origin self, length 10, damage 2d6, throw 6): boulder rolls out from the caster along the line, hitting/knocking creatures on the way, and rests as a boulder at the end.
evidence: creatures: 'goblin 1 at 198,283 hp 10/10' after wait; cell 198,277 'grass, height 0, gas dust 1'; census r=14 no boulder/pillar terrain. Reproduced on a second try at 400,400 with goblin at 400,395: also unhurt.

title: Line spells with x,y target act only on the target cell; same spell with dir only hits creature on the line
steps: fresh; spawn goblin 198,283 (caster 198,287); cast frost x=198 y=277 charge 3; wait 30; census r=6 at 198,281 (only 3 frost cells, goblin 10/10); then cast frost dir=0 charge 3 with no x,y
happened: Frost aimed with x,y=198,277 put frost on ~3 cells at the target and skipped the goblin between (also wave: 'ground churns to mud' at target only, goblin untouched). Frost with dir=0 and no x,y: 'Goblin takes 6 frost damage (4/10 HP)' and frost over 13 cells.
expected: Line spells (origin self, 40 ft) affect the whole line from the caster toward the clicked cell, as dir-cast does, including creatures in between.
evidence: After x,y cast: creatures 'goblin 1 at 198,283 hp 10/10'; census r=6: cover:frost=3. After dir cast log: 'Goblin takes 6 frost damage (4/10 HP)'. Likely same cause as rolling boulder note.

title: Rolling Boulder with dir only does roll and hit; with x,y it does not (confirms earlier two notes)
steps: fresh; spawn goblin 198,283; cast rolling-boulder dir=0 charge 3 (no x,y); wait 80
happened: 'Goblin takes 7 rolling boulder damage (0/10 HP) | Goblin is defeated | The ice cracks | The rolling boulder comes to rest'. The same spell with x=198,y=277 left goblin 10/10.
expected: Aiming by x,y should roll the boulder along the line toward that cell, same as dir.
evidence: creatures: None after dir cast; goblin 1 hp 10/10 after x,y cast.

title: Ray of Frost / Wave aimed by x,y skip creature on the line (same as Frost/Rolling Boulder)
steps: fresh; spawn goblin 198,282 (caster 198,287); cast ray-of-frost x=198 y=279; wait 30; creatures. Also cast wave x=198 y=270 charge 3 with goblin at 198,282, vs wave dir=0 which logs 'The wave knocks Goblin back'.
happened: x,y casts: goblin stays 10/10 at its cell, only the target cell is changed (frozen / mud). dir=0 wave moved the goblin from 198,282 to 198,271 and logged 'The wave knocks Goblin back'.
expected: Line spells starting at the caster should affect everything along the line toward the clicked cell.
evidence: creatures after x,y casts: 'goblin 2 at 198,282 hp 10/10'. After dir cast: 'goblin 1 at 198,271'.

title: Earthen Trench aimed by x,y digs only at the target, not a channel from the caster's feet
steps: fresh (continuing same session); caster at 198,287; cast earthen-trench x=198 y=275 charge 3; wait 30; census r=6 at 198,281; cell 198,283
happened: census shows t:dirt=2 and the rest grass; 198,283 (between caster and target) is untouched grass height 0.
expected: Blurb: 'Gouges a 40 ft channel two steps deep from your feet toward where you click' - the cells along the line should be dug.
evidence: cell 198,283: 'grass, height 0, liquid water 3'; census: 't:dirt=2 t:grass=167'. Same family as the Rolling Boulder/Frost/Wave x,y notes; dir-only casts do cover the line.

title: Move Earth at corner 0,0 does nothing
steps: fresh; cast move-earth x=0 y=0 charge 3; cell 0,0
happened: Says Cast, cell 0,0 stays grass height 0. The same spell at 205,280 gave height 2.
expected: Hill peak raised at the target, or a refusal message
evidence: cell 0,0 -> 'grass, height 0'; the cast reported no error

title: Lava Pool leaves water and frost in the cell
steps: fresh; cast sleet-storm 205,287 c3; create-water 205,287 c3; lava-pool 205,287; wait 100
happened: Lava cell showed liquid water 18 and cover frost together with lava-pool at heat 300; it later set to rock still holding water 18 and frost
expected: Lava should boil or replace the water and melt the frost
evidence: cell 205,287: 'rock, height -3, liquid water 18, cover frost'
